what_works: Each maker gets a small named bio with portrait + workshop photo — perfect translation for a 'meet the owner' contractor block. Soft cream backgrounds with warm wood-tone product photography sells the human-made provenance.
what_does_not_translate: The curated-marketplace structure (browse-by-maker) doesn't map to a single-owner contractor — keep the bio composition, drop the catalog grid.
type_observations: Old-style serif headlines (Caslon-like) paired with neutral sans body — the serif carries the heritage signal alone.
